name: hud_cmd_bind_button_base_constructor
description: HudCmdBindButtonBase::Constructor initializes the check-toggle base, embedded bind panel, binding vector, layout offsets, slot counters, class dispatch state, spacing, and selected binding index.
known_limits: None: VC5SP3 byte verification passes for the actual class constructor symbol.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4b8d30 calls the check-toggle base constructor, constructs the embedded bindPanel as a HudUiListSelectorItem, constructs the empty binding vector, zeros slot counters, panel pointer, and list offsets, sets bindingSlotSpacing to 15, sets selectedBindingIndex to -1, and returns this.

Native smoke verifies typed list-selector item state, embedded bind panel state, binding-vector state, slot count/pointer fields, spacing, selected index, and offset fields without VTable/FTable assertions.
